title: Lightning and Sun Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Retro Science Graphic Tee, Weather Lover Gift
intro:
A fiery Sun, electric-blue lightning bolt, and distressed lettering give this science design a retro poster feel. Lightning Is Hotter Than the Surface of the Sun makes a bold statement for weather fans, physics enthusiasts, and science teachers.

THE FACT BEHIND THE DESIGN
The slogan compares lightning with the Sun’s visible surface. Lightning can heat the air around it to around 50,000°F, exceeding the temperature of the Sun’s surface.
